entities.name: Benoît Saint Denis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Benoît Saint Denis, also known by his initials BSD, is a French professional mixed martial artist and former French Army Special Forces soldier who currently competes in the lightweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). As of February 3, 2026, he is #5 in the UFC lightweight rankings.
